Product Description

The Kodak PIXPRO FZ55 is a compact digital camera designed for simple everyday photography, offering an easy way to capture trips, family moments, or casual creative projects. It uses a sixteen MP CMOS sensor and a five times optical zoom lens, with a twenty eight mm wide angle setting that helps frame landscapes and group photos. The camera records one thousand eighty p full HD video for short clips or basic vlogging, and the two point seven inch LCD screen makes it easy to review images and adjust settings. A rechargeable li-ion battery supports use throughout the day, and the camera accepts class ten SD, SDHC, or SDXC memory cards up to five hundred twelve GB. The slim, lightweight body fits comfortably in a pocket or small bag for quick access on the go. With straightforward controls and familiar menus, the FZ55 provides a practical option for users who want a simple point and shoot camera without added complexity.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    affordable "handy dandy" digi !
    I love how easy it is to use this little digi ! It has force flash, usb-c charging, and it is the perfect size. Easy to manage settings and filters make it the right choice for any project. I bought some accessories to go with it, such as the sd reader for my phone, as well as a travel case to ensure i could slip it into any bag. & I literally dont go anywhere without it! I love the photo quality! I get the best candids and quick shots ever with this camera, I really do recommend!! I take a lot of photos of my family & friends that are SUPER cute and good quality but i included what little faceless photos i have from the camera to show indoor quality vs outdoor low lighting!

      5 out of 5 stars
      I recommend this camera!!
      Reviewed in the United States on May 15, 2026
      Color: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I actually love this camera. Its appearance is nice and compact, it's strap that it comes with held up so far. Its auto focus is actually pretty good for the price this camera goes for! The settings are pretty simple and straightforward. It's definitely a budget option for someone starting out like me but actually nice. The battery life is LONG, I've only had to charge it like two or three times since I got it. I think I have taken it on a few trips by now.

      Now I admit a lot of photos I had taken the first few times after I got it, were pretty blurry but after figuring out how to do the auto focus (half press the shutter button, fully pressing down after the green outlined rectangle appears), photos were not blurry.

      The durability of the camera seems pretty good in all honesty.

      Overall, I heavily recommend this for any beginner photographers out there like me who can't just throw out a bunch of money on a digital camera. I wouldn't say this camera is good for a while, like to use for professional photos but it's a start for sure!

      TLDR: Great camera for cheap
      Reviewed in the United States on August 2, 2026
      Color: Red
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Really great digi for cheap! I was initially a little skeptical about buying since I wanted the photos to be high-quality and still have that nostalgic feel to them, but this camera does it all! It's simple to change the temperature settings and easy to understand for someone who never uses cameras except for the one on my phone. Videos are also fairly good quality; the camera is extremely shaky, though, so make sure you're either okay with that or you get a hand-held stabilizer.

      I bought it for a concert, and it fulfilled my every wish! Just be warned, the item DOES NOT come with an SD card; you'll have to buy it separately, but I got a 64gb one that fits a TON of photos on here. Battery life isn't that bad either; I'd just recommend charging your camera the night before you take it out for an entire day.

    • Cataptra
      5 out of 5 stars
      Kodak FZ-55 PixPro Camera - Black version
      Reviewed in the United States on March 13, 2023
      Color: Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      DISLIKES: No external charger for the battery. Most digital cameras I have purchased in the past always came with an external charger. This one only charges the battery internally, unless you buy an external charger, which I would highly recommend one always have an external charger for extra/spare batteries for your camera! Also didn't like you only access the manual by reading or downloading on-line. What is wrong with manufacturers today? They SHOULD supply manuals with their products, no matter what it is. Not have the end user go hunting for it, and many times when I went seeking a manual for a product I bought, if the manufacturer may have discontinued the item, they tend to remove the manual, and now it's no longer available to access, even though you may have bought the item new, no manual with it is just dumb and lazy on their part. If I am printing it on paper, then they sure didn't save any trees, and maybe I had to print it several times before I got the fomatting right to put it in a notebook or folder for future reference, wasting paper and more trees. Manufactures take notice, you ARE NOT doing the trees or the end user any favor by EXCLUDING manuals from your products!

      LIKES:

      Easy to use, but then I have been accustomed to digital cameras for a very long time, so I can navigate around them very easily, and I found this one very easy to navigateonce I checked out all the buttons and what they did. Has a nice LCD screen for viewing your photo's after taking the shots, one thing I don't quite understand is the "slideshow", you get 3 options to pick from #1, #2 or #3, #1 just shows the basic snapshot and really does nothing. #2 will do some type of effect, as does #3, but to me, they make no rhyme or reason for even being there at all.

      They don't copy to your computer when transferring the photo's to your computer, you'd have to use another program, like some kind of video editor to create a slide show with similar or like effects. And the issue is, it's NOT a slide show of the photo's in the camera or on the SD Card, it only affects the ONE PHOTO you're viewing, so it's not a slideshow by any means. When I selected it to see what it did, it just affected the one photo I was viewing, I had expected to see a slideshow of ALL the photo's I had taken or be allowed to select a specific number to create a slideshow that could be saved as a video exported file from the camera, but none of that is possible. Waste of a camera resource in my opinion.

      The photos are good, and I have attached a few here to show the cameras' capability in low light conditions, the two photo's of the same kitten (Cordellia-001/-002) are indoors in low light, the older cat (Apollo), taken outside is nearing sunset. Forgive the messy look of the floor inside the house, we're in the process of removing the carpeting from our house, and we're just starting work on it, so the floors look a tad messy for the time being.

      Even with the Dislikes and the few faults it has, I can recommend the camera, it seems to take nice photographs, I haven't tried videos as yet, I have some projects in mind for that for YouTube later on. I mostly purchased this camera for still photos when on nature walks or other outside activities that may be photo-worthy.

    • C Bartlett
      5 out of 5 stars
      Easy to use to get great looking photos
      Reviewed in Canada on August 3, 2026
      Color: Red
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I really did not expect the camera to be as compact as what it actually is. It is very light in weight and can be put into a pocket which is especially great for travel. It has all the functions I would expect in a high end camera but without changeable lenses. I tried various functions with taking photos and am very happy with the end results I received. Adjustments are very easy to go from one setting to another, the zoom is shown extended. I took the photo of the BBQ with flower pot on top the morning after a rain, sun was shining on the cover sand steam coming off of it. I am amazed at the pic taken from inside my house out to the patio actually shows the steam. Battery and camera card is easy to access. I really like that the rechargeable battery can be charged inside the camera by using the included cord without being removed. This will come with me on all my adventures. Wrist strap is nice to have also. You need to purchase your own camera card which I prefer to do anyways.
